WeaponTraitDef.label: holoscope
WeaponTraitDef.description: An advanced holographic sight. Its clear reticle speeds up target acquisition and improves accuracy.

WeaponTraitDef.label: 2x scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: A 2x optic that makes targets larger and clearer. It makes precise shots easier.

WeaponTraitDef.label: 4x scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: A 4x optic built for medium to long engagements. It lets the shooter aim more clearly at distant targets, slightly increasing the weapon's maximum effective range.

WeaponTraitDef.label: 8x scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: An 8x optic made for long-range shooting. Its high magnification places distant targets clearly in view, letting the shooter hit targets at the weapon's range limit.
